questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Moldova about 33,844 square kilometres; Slovenia about 20,271 square kilometres; Montenegro about 13,883 square kilometres; Cyprus about 9,242 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Chișinău?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Moldova is Chișinău.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Moldova on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Moldova on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Moldova?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Moldova on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Moldova article.

questions.proof: It borders Ukraine to the east and Romania to the west.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Moldova?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Moldova article.

questions.proof: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău.
